description: MTA Subway End-to-End Running Times: Beginning 2019 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. This dataset provides information on the actual end-to-end running times for subway trips between their origin and destination stations, including the average, and 25th, 50th (median), and 75th percentile running times in minutes, along with the scheduled end-to-end running time in minutes for these trips. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are new york city transit, speeds, service, schedules, scheduled service. The table has 20 columns. Attribution on the portal: Metropolitan Transportation Authority. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
